title: Exact request-bound review and LLM candidate projection
summary: Dynamic Story dev3 requires a privileged, fresh host review for exact request tenant, market, channel, locale, policy selection, intention/narrative revisions and full ordered claim inventory. A selected narrative is not a publication or dispatch grant.
invariants: An ALLOW status or proof reference alone cannot grant publication. The host must freshly verify operative policy, claims, consent and live holds.
Incorrect or replayed response bindings block narrative emission: tenant, request, country, channel, locale, claims, policy selection, selected revisions.
Agent projection omits request identifier, proof and dispatch authority; the LLM composes only a candidate response.
Intention Service is independently owned and resolves user meaning; Brand Narrative Directive NO_DISPATCH is not elevated by Dynamic Story.
Host review authenticity, request ID uniqueness, live claim withdrawal and exact ooRexx r13196 tests remain unqualified.
